## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo fmt --all -- --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo test --workspace` pass
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the change
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated (section « Non publié ») if the change is visible to users
- [ ] Docs updated (`README`, `docs/guides`, ADR) if behaviour or configuration changed
- [ ] **No real data**: fixtures, screenshots and examples are fictitious (`example.org`, `192.0.2.0/24`)
- [ ] No new default that is specific to one site: configuration does it
- [ ] Privacy: no new view of an individual without an entry in the audit log
